title: Otomat
summary: Open a payment channel, lock tokens, and settle a payer-signed check through an Ed25519 pre-instruction.
what: Otomat is an Anchor 0.31.1 payment-channel rail. open_channel (seeds ["channel", payer, payee, mint]) funds an ATA owned by an escrow_auth PDA (seeds ["escrow_auth", channel]). close_channel, signed by the facilitator, settles a cumulative amount to the payee and refunds the rest, but only after instruction 0 is an Ed25519 verification of the payer's check: `otomat/v2/check|` || channel || cumulative_le || nonce_le || expiry_le.
app_note: The page at /dapps/otomat/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/otomat. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/otomat/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already opened a 2_000_000-token channel, rejected a close without Ed25519, then settled a 1_000_000 check.
try_steps.see: Program 343pmZcq…. Channel 3zfGyMqw… and escrow ATA 9GeU2hYH… should be closed; payee 4262h4DM… received 1_000_000.

diagram: payer --open_channel--> channel+escrow ATA; facilitator --close_channel + Ed25519(payer check)--> payee ATA + refund, accounts closed.
accounts: channel PDA seeds ["channel", payer, payee, mint]
innovation: Settlement is a facilitator-submitted, payer-signed off-chain check verified by the Ed25519 precompile; the program also checks that the pre-instruction's offsets point at its own data.
frontend: Generic IDL console at /dapps/otomat/. close_channel requires an Ed25519 pre-instruction as ix 0.
exercises: Reconstruct the check message for a 1_000_000 cumulative and nonce 1.
What error is returned if close_channel has no Ed25519 pre-instruction?
not_covered: Unilateral dispute, timeout reclaim, receipts, and facilitator bonds
objectives: Open a channel PDA and lock tokens for payer→payee.
Explain why the Ed25519 pre-instruction matters for settle.
Settle a signed check and verify balances after settlement.
prereqs: A Devnet wallet with practice funds and the lesson mint.
Comfortable with multi-instruction transactions (Foundations 004 or equivalent).
student_outcome: Settle a payer-signed check and explain why close/settle needs the Ed25519 pre-instruction.

learning_loop.objective: Inspect channel settle/close — then predict Missing Ed25519 pre-instruction failure.
learning_loop.predict_question: close_channel (or settle path that requires the check) is sent without an Ed25519 pre-instruction. What should happen?

predict_options.label: Instruction fails because the Ed25519 pre-instruction is missing
Close succeeds but skips balance updates

learning_loop.predict_why: Otomat verifies payer-signed checks via an Ed25519 pre-instruction. Without it, close/settle fails rather than moving channel funds on an unchecked path.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/otomat/ on Devnet. Prefer recorded open channel + rejected close-without-precompile + successful settle proofs. Reconstruct the check message for cumulative 1_000_000 / nonce 1 when prompted by the exercise.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why must the Ed25519 pre-instruction accompany settle/close instead of trusting a raw payer pubkey field?
learning_loop.transfer: Name one check field (cumulative/nonce) and one not_covered path (unilateral dispute/timeout).

assessment.purpose: Independent elective criteria; no Picassol leakage.

criteria.title: Locates channel PDA
criteria.question: Can the student identify the channel and locked tokens?
criteria.misconception: Payer wallet is the channel vault.

criteria.title: Explains Ed25519 requirement
criteria.question: Can the student predict failure without the pre-instruction?

criteria.title: Evidence honesty
criteria.question: Routes labelled?
criteria.misconception: Lab settle is my dispute win.
